arxiv-2105-14712.title: Can a pure state remain pure in the Unruh effect?
arxiv-2105-14712.creator: Saptarshi Saha, Arpan Chatterjee, Chiranjeeb Singha
arxiv-2105-14712.description: Abstract A uniformly accelerated detector in an inertial vacuum undergoes an unavoidable dissipation, and the final steady-state becomes thermal. However, to attain such a mixed state, there is no bound for the acceleration of the single atomic detector. Here we show that the scenario is entirely different for two atoms with the same energy levels.

arxiv-2108-07414.title: Stability and Generalization for Randomized Coordinate Descent To appear in IJCAI 2021
arxiv-2108-07414.creator: Puyu Wang, Liang Wu, Yunwen Lei
arxiv-2108-07414.description: Abstract Randomized coordinate descent (RCD) is a popular optimization algorithm with wide applications in solving various machine learning problems, which motivates a lot of theoretical analysis on its convergence behavior. As a comparison, there is no work studying how the models trained by RCD would generalize to test examples.

arxiv-2109-13869.title: Corona splashing triggered by a loose monolayer of particles
arxiv-2109-13869.creator: Ehsan Esmaili 1,3 , Zih-Yin Chen 2 , Anupam Pandey 1 , Seungho Kim 1 , Sungyon Lee 2 and Sunghwan Jung 1
arxiv-2109-13869.description: Abstract In nature, high-speed raindrops often impact and spread on particulate surfaces (e.g., soil, plant leaves with spores or pollen). We study the dynamics of droplet impact on a loosely packed monolayer of particles by combining experimental and mathematical approaches.

arxiv-2203-13507.title: On extremes of random clusters and marked renewal cluster processes

We start by studying the tail behaviour of an individual cluster and then we apply the developed theory to determine the limiting distribution of max { X j : j = 0 , … , K ( t ) } \max\{X_{j}:j=0,\ldots,K(t)\} , where K ⁡ ( t ) K(t) is the number of i.i.d.

arxiv-2204-06380.title: Communication Efficient Curvature Aided Primal-dual Algorithms for Decentralized Optimization
arxiv-2204-06380.creator: Yichuan Li, Petros G. Voulgaris, Dušan M. Stipanović, Nikolaos M. Freris
arxiv-2204-06380.description: Abstract This paper presents a family of algorithms for decentralized convex composite problems. We consider the setting of a network of agents that cooperatively minimize a global objective function composed of a sum of local functions plus a regularizer. Through the use of intermediate consensus variables, we remove the need for inner communication loops between agents when computing curvature-guided updates.

arxiv-2301-09749.title: A Data-Efficient Visual-Audio Representation with Intuitive Fine-tuning for Voice-Controlled Robots
arxiv-2301-09749.creator: Peixin Chang, Shuijing Liu, Tianchen Ji, Neeloy Chakraborty
arxiv-2301-09749.description: Abstract A command-following robot that serves people in everyday life must continually improve itself in deployment domains with minimal help from its end users, instead of engineers. Previous methods are either difficult to continuously improve after the deployment or require a large number of new labels during fine-tuning.

arxiv-2312-02577.title: Fibonacci or Lucas numbers that are products of two Lucas numbers or two Fibonacci numbers
arxiv-2312-02577.creator: Ahmet Daşdemir, Ahmet Emin
arxiv-2312-02577.description: Abstract This contribution presents all possible solutions to the Diophantine equations F k = L m ​ L n F_{k}=L_{m}L_{n} and L k = F m ​ F n L_{k}=F_{m}F_{n} . To be clear, Fibonacci numbers that are the product of two arbitrary Lucas numbers and Lucas numbers that are the product of two arbitrary Fibonacci numbers are determined herein.

arxiv-2404-12871.title: Expanding the Katz Index for Link Prediction: A Case Study on a Live Fish Movement Network
arxiv-2404-12871.creator: Michael-Sam Vidza, Marcin Budka, Wei Koong Chai, Mark Thrush, Mickael Teixeira Alves
arxiv-2404-12871.description: Abstract In aquaculture, disease spread models often neglect the dynamic interactions between farms, hindering accuracy. This study enhances the Katz index (KI) to incorporate spatial and temporal patterns of fish movement, improving the prediction of farms susceptible to disease via live fish transfers.

arxiv-2406-02083.description: Abstract We present spectropolarimetric observations of an active region recorded simultaneously in the H α \alpha and the Ca II 8662 Å lines. The sunspot exhibits multiple structures, including a lightbridge and a region where Ca II 8662 Å line core is in emission.

arxiv-2503-09789.title: Model-Agnostic Uncertainty Quantification for Fast NFC Tag Identification using RF Fingerprinting
arxiv-2503-09789.creator: Dickson Akuoko Sarpong, Adam Kamrath, Rohit Bhusal, and Hongzhi Guo
arxiv-2503-09789.description: Abstract Near Field Communication (NFC) is widely used in security applications such as door access systems and ID cards. However, clone attacks can replicate digital information, enabling unauthorized access. RF fingerprinting offers a robust defense by extracting unique physical-layer features from NFC cards that cannot be cloned.

arxiv-2505-20038.title: Towards Video to Piano Music Generation with Chain-of-Perform Support Benchmarks
arxiv-2505-20038.creator: Chang Liu, Haomin Zhang, Shiyu Xia, Zihao Chen, Chaofan Ding, Xin Yue, Huizhe Chen, Xinhan Di
arxiv-2505-20038.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chang Liu, Haomin Zhang, Shiyu Xia, Zihao Chen, Chaofan Ding, Xin Yue, Huizhe Chen, Xinhan Di. Generating high-quality piano audio from video requires precise synchronization between visual cues and musical output, ensuring accurate semantic and temporal alignment. However, existing evaluation datasets do not to fully capture the intricate synchronization required for piano music generation.

arxiv-2601-07935.title: Towards Specialized Generalists: A Multi-Task MoE-LoRA Framework for Domain-Specific LLM Adaptation
arxiv-2601-07935.creator: Yuxin Yang, Aoxiong Zeng, Xiangquan Yang
arxiv-2601-07935.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuxin Yang, Aoxiong Zeng, Xiangquan Yang. The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) has shifted focus from general-purpose capabilities to domain-specific expertise. However, adapting LLMs to specialized fields such as medicine presents two challenge: (1) the “Stability-Plasticity Dilemma”, where the model must acquire complex clinical knowledge without suffering from catastrophic forgetting of general world knowledge; and (2) “Task Interference”, where disparate sub-tasks—such as medical diagnosis, report summarization, and drug-drug interaction prediction—compete for limited low-rank parameter space.

arxiv-2602-21158.title: SELAUR: Self Evolving LLM Agent via Uncertainty-aware Rewards
arxiv-2602-21158.creator: Dengjia Zhang, Xiaoou Liu, Lu Cheng, Yaqing Wang, Kenton Murray, Hua Wei
arxiv-2602-21158.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-step decision-making agents, where effective reward design is essential for guiding learning. Although recent work explores various forms of reward shaping and step-level credit assignment, a key signal remains largely overlooked: the intrinsic uncertainty of LLMs.

pmc-10510232.creator: Tianhua Fan, Liansheng Ma
pmc-10510232.description: Background and purposeOvarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) is one of the most serious iatrogenic complications in assisted reproductive technology, which seem rarely associated with cerebrovascular diseases. We reported a patient diagnosed with OHSS combined with carotid artery dissection and massive cerebral infarction.

pmc-10571970.title: Yak-Derived CXCL14 Activates the Pro-Inflammatory Response of Macrophages and Inhibits the Proliferation and Migration of HepG2

pmc-11502263.title: Challenges for the legislation enabling egg donation in Switzerland
pmc-11502263.creator: Andrea Martani, Nathalie Neeser, Nicolas Vulliemoz, Guido Pennings
pmc-11502263.description: Switzerland is one of the most restrictive countries in Europe when it comes to the regulation of egg donation in medically assisted reproduction (MAR). Indeed, even after the introduction of modifications to the law regulating reproductive medicine allowing embryo culture, embryo freezing, and preimplantation genetic testing, egg donation has remained completely forbidden.

pmc-11689173.title: CALLING OUT AGEISM: HOW INTERSECTING IDENTITIES AND CONFRONTATION TONE AFFECT PERCEPTIONS OF OLDER CONFRONTERS
pmc-11689173.creator: Hannah Gans, Alison Chasteen, Michelle Horhota
pmc-11689173.description: The few studies that have examined confrontations of ageism have shown that older adults are viewed differently after challenging the behavior. What remains unclear is how older people’s intersecting identities, as well as their confrontation tone, might influence reactions to their countering ageism.

pmc-12394892.title: Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition in Cancer: Insights Into Therapeutic Targets and Clinical Implications
pmc-12394892.creator: Dhasarathdev Srinivasan, Ranjith Balakrishnan, Ankush Chauhan, Jeevan Kumar, Dinesh Murugan Girija, Reena Shrestha, Rupendra Shrestha, Rajasekaran Subbarayan
pmc-12394892.description: Radiation therapy is a fundamental component of cancer treatment, benefiting 50%–70% of patients by selectively targeting malignant tissues. However, radioresistance remains a significant challenge, often driven by epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT). EMT increases cancer invasiveness and metastasis by upregulating mesenchymal markers, including vimentin and N‐cadherin, and downregulating epithelial markers, such as E‐cadherin.

pmc-12952632.title: Development of immortalized Callithrix jacchus kidney cell lines supporting infection with a panel of viruses
pmc-12952632.creator: Sabine Gärtner, Pamela Stomberg, Stefan Pöhlmann, Michael Winkler
pmc-12952632.description: Common marmosets (Callithrix jacchus) are valuable non-human primate (NHP) animal models in biomedical research, including infectious diseases modelling. However, for in vitro studies only a few immortalized cell lines have been generated, and additional lines are needed to comply with the 3R principles of replacement, reduction and refinement.

pmc-13041498.title: Oral health, orofacial pain and dysfunction, and orofacial trauma in athletes: a scoping review
pmc-13041498.creator: G Bousché, F Lobbezoo, R de Vries, M C Verhoeff
pmc-13041498.description: BackgroundTo provide an extensive overview of the available literature on (i) oral health, (ii) orofacial pain and dysfunction, and (iii) maxillofacial and/or dental trauma in athletes, including their possible associated factors and the impact of oral health and orofacial pain and dysfunction on sport performances and quality of life.MethodsA literature search was performed up to May 13, 2025.

pmc-13043742.title: Using electronic health records to assess the relationship between colonization pressure and nosocomial pathogen acquisition
pmc-13043742.creator: Luke Sagers, Ziming Wei, Caroline McKenna, Christina Chan, Anna A Agan, Theodore R Pak, Chanu Rhee, Michael Klompas, Sanjat Kanjilal
pmc-13043742.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hospitalized patients are at risk for developing hospital acquired infections. Active surveillance for bacterial colonization is effective at preventing infection but is resource-intensive and limited to high-risk units and a subset of high-risk pathogens. Colonization pressure, defined as the prevalence of an organism among ward co-occupants, has been associated with hospital acquired infection and can be calculated in real-time using data in the electronic health record, but its use by infection control programs has been limited.

pmc-13129864.title: Influence of Nano-TiO2 Particle Size on Fresh, Physical, Mechanical, Photocatalytic, and Cost Performance of Cement Mortars
pmc-13129864.creator: Zehra Funda Akbulut
pmc-13129864.description: Nanosized additives have attracted significant attention for improving cement-based materials; however, the isolated effects of nano-TiO2 (NT) particle size and dosage on engineering performance and photocatalytic efficiency remain unclear. This study investigates NT with particle sizes of 15–35 nm and 55–75 nm incorporated at 1–3% replacement levels in cement mortars at a constant water-to-binder ratio of 0.5.

pmc-13145901.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1579 THE MINIFLOW STUDY: EVALUATING NON-INVASIVE IMAGING MODALITIES FOR FOLLOW-UP OF FLOW DIVERTER STENT TREATED CEREBRAL ANEURYSMS

Background and aimsThis study aimed to evaluate subtraction CT angiography (sCTA) and MR angiography (MRA) as potential non-invasive alternatives for digital subtraction angiography (DSA) for the follow-up of intracranial aneurysms treated with flow diverter stent (FDS).MethodsForty patients with intracranial aneurysms treated with FDS were enrolled between August 2019 and November 2024 to evaluate the diagnostic performance of sCTA and MRA in assessment of aneurysm occlusion after FDS treatment. All patients were scheduled to undergo sCTA, MRA and DSA within 24 hours.

pmc-13185259.title: The relationship between treatment methods and depressive mood in patients with low back pain: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13185259.creator: Şeyma Ceylan, İsmail Arslan, Merve Koşucu, Duygu Yengil Taci
pmc-13185259.description: BackgroundLow back pain is widely recognized as a frequent health concern affecting many individuals in the community, and treatment options are wide-ranging. This study investigated the association of depressive mood with treatment approaches used or preferred by patients with low back pain.

pmc-13408875.title: A Non-Stationary Geometry-Based MIMO Channel Model for Terahertz UAV-Based Wireless Communication Systems
pmc-13408875.creator: Zican Jiang, Yongjun Li, Kai Zhang, Jianguo Liu
pmc-13408875.description: UAV-assisted communication is widely regarded as a key component of next-generation Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks (SAGINs), where integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) further drives the demand for accurate and reliable channel modeling. Terahertz (THz) communications are particularly attractive for UAV platforms, offering ultra-high data rates and physically secure transmission.

pmc-13610850.title: Beyond Disposability: A Systematic Review of Reusable and Single-Use Products in Hygiene-Related Nursing Care in the ICU

pmc-13610850.description: Background/Objectives: Intensive care is resource-intensive, and routine nursing hygiene contributes substantially to material consumption. This systematic review synthesised evidence comparing single-use and reusable or traditional reusable products in hygiene-related nursing care in intensive and critical care settings, considering clinical, economic, and environmental outcomes.
